stories.title: Rust workspace and doctor command
stories.objective: Create the Cargo workspace, binary entrypoint, structured errors, and a `fabric doctor --json` command reporting platform and tool discovery without network calls.
acceptance: `cargo test --workspace` passes from a clean checkout
`fabric doctor --json` yields parseable JSON and explicit Linux support status

stories.title: Domain IDs, state transitions, and policy validation
stories.objective: Implement typed IDs, Run/Workspace/PreparedState state machines, and validation for storage and retention policy.
acceptance: Illegal transitions fail with typed errors
No I/O required to test state transitions

stories.title: SQLite store and migrations
stories.objective: Implement SQLite schema, idempotent migrations, transactions and atomic creation/transitions of run, project, state and workspace rows.
acceptance: Foreign keys prevent orphan records
Concurrent creation does not duplicate IDs
Restart reopens persisted rows

stories.title: Git source resolver and project registration
stories.objective: Register local Git repo and resolve pinned HEAD SHA without importing uncommitted source edits.
acceptance: Dirty checkout gets warning and commit remains pinned
Non-Git path yields actionable error
`project status --json` reports source SHA

stories.title: Preparation recipe parser and fingerprint
stories.objective: Parse trusted TOML recipe, validate argv and limits, compute deterministic preparation digest from commit and declared recipe/environment.
acceptance: Equivalent inputs same digest
Changing recipe or commit changes digest
Invalid recipe rejected before command start

stories.title: Prepare local project snapshot
stories.objective: Clone pinned source into Fabric staging directory, run preparation commands in clone, register immutable READY prepared state on successful completion.
acceptance: Recipe creates ignored `.deps/ready` marker
Preparation failure does not publish READY
Developer original repo remains unchanged

stories.title: Preparation cache reuse and invalidation
stories.objective: Reuse READY prepared state for unchanged key, serialize concurrent preparation requests, handle incomplete stage recovery.
acceptance: Recipe counter increments only once for duplicate requests
New commit or changed recipe creates separate state
Interrupted staging never appears READY

stories.title: Managed workspace fork backend
stories.objective: Implement isolated forks of entire prepared tree, including ignored dependencies, with reflink when available and size-admitted copy fallback.
acceptance: Fork retains ignored prepared dependencies
Fork does not rerun setup
Writable files are never hardlinked to base

stories.title: Workspace isolation and ownership registration
stories.objective: Persist workspace ownership before use, attach Run ID, validate managed paths and ensure private writes do not affect siblings.
acceptance: Two forks write same relative path differently
Prepared base remains unchanged
Every workspace has exactly one owner

stories.title: Fake harness and one-worker foreground supervisor
stories.objective: Implement HarnessAdapter abstraction, deterministic fake binary, foreground runner capturing result and exit status.
acceptance: Run lifecycle transitions recorded
Nonzero exit becomes FAILED
Run provenance includes input digests and source SHA

stories.title: OMP headless harness adapter
stories.objective: Probe OMP and launch `omp -p --mode json` safely from a private workspace, parse bounded JSONL events and record version.
acceptance: Argument vector passes prompt verbatim
Mocked OMP stdout JSONL parsed
Missing OMP has clear diagnostic

stories.title: Bounded stdout stderr and event capture
stories.objective: Add capped log files, truncation markers, structured event persistence and checksums.
acceptance: 100 MiB fake output does not exceed 10 MiB configured log cap
Truncation reported in run metadata
Capture does not deadlock on full pipes

stories.title: Concurrency-limited run-many
stories.objective: Run task manifest with bounded parallelism, independent Run IDs, batch result and per-worker workspace.
acceptance: Four tasks with cap 2 have max 2 active
All tasks retain separate run results
Batch overall status reports any failures

stories.title: Process groups, timeout, and cancel
stories.objective: Use Linux process-group supervision to terminate worker and descendants on timeout/cancel; record outcome.
acceptance: Fake parent spawning child is fully stopped
Timeout marks run appropriately
Cancellation is idempotent

stories.title: Tracked source change artifacts
stories.objective: Capture `git diff HEAD --binary`, stdout/stderr manifest, SHA256 checksums and provenance before marking work cleanup-eligible.
acceptance: Tracked edits survive post-run
Manifest references exact base SHA, prompt digest, harness version
Capture failure prevents reclaim

stories.title: Untracked artifact collection and safe failure
stories.objective: Capture size-bounded non-ignored untracked files without following external symlinks, and safely retain workspace if capture fails.
acceptance: Non-ignored untracked files restored accurately
Oversize capture moves workspace to RECOVERY_REQUIRED
Outside symlink target is not read

stories.title: Path-safe idempotent garbage collection
stories.objective: Implement lease-aware cleanup, root/path marker validation, symlink refusal, dry-run and interruption recovery.
acceptance: Symlink substitution refuses deletion
Interrupted cleanup resumes safely
Unique source changes never deleted before verified capture

stories.title: Storage budgets and admission control
stories.objective: Implement injected storage meter, free-space reserve, managed root budget, workspace usage checks and cleanup before admission.
acceptance: Simulated low free space rejects launch before starting process
Reported cache/workspace usage exposes retention reasons
Oversize workspaces stop with clear outcome

stories.title: Lease reconciliation and crash recovery
stories.objective: Persist lease owner and expiry; reconcile interrupted runs fail-closed without killing unverifiable processes or deleting unique data.
acceptance: Expired lease does not equal permission to delete
Interrupted run goes NEEDS_ATTENTION or safe terminal state
Reconciliation is repeatable

stories.title: CLI inspection and end-to-end acceptance
stories.objective: Implement project/runs/storage show and GC dry-run JSON commands, smoke-test complete prepare/fork/run/artifact/reclaim fixture workflow, write operator guide.
acceptance: Project, run, storage and GC commands are inspectable
AT-01 through AT-14 pass in CI
`cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy -D warnings`, and full tests pass
Manual OMP smoke instructions documented; execution separately verified
